title: EMTRF: Evidence-Monotone Terrain Representation Framework
description: Reference implementation and reproducibility package for the Evidence-Monotone Terrain Representation Framework (EMTRF): an operator contract that carries provenance, per-channel support, applicability and complete-source lineage through representation-only operations, with Evidence-Constrained Douglas-Peucker (EC-DP) as the reference instance and EC-wrap as a retrofit for other simplifiers. One command (./run_all.sh) reruns every analysis of the accompanying Computers & Geosciences manuscript and checks each reported value; steps whose optional tools or data are absent are reported as not run. Includes the 60 crops of the USGS 3DEP probability sample and the external CC0 audit data; see DATA_LICENSES.md.
